name: nft-accept-accept-peer-second-chain
description: accept-peer with a later chain already dropping the peer
setup: nft add chain inet f out "{ type filter hook output priority 0; policy accept; }"
nft add chain inet f late "{ type filter hook output priority 10; policy accept; }"
nft add rule inet f late ip daddr 10.5.5.2 drop

action.spec: nft add rule inet f out ip daddr 10.5.5.2 accept
